questions.prompt: Which ancient city was located at the eastern end of the Mediterranean and famed for purple dye?
questions.fact: The dye came from sea snails, and producing a single gram required thousands of them.
There are around 300 million of them, and their combined surface area is roughly that of a tennis court.

questions.prompt: In tennis, how many sets must a man win to take a Grand Slam match?
questions.fact: Best of five is used only at the four majors, and the longest recorded match ran over eleven hours across three days.

questions.prompt: Which streaming platform produced The Mandalorian?
questions.fact: It was shot against a curved LED wall displaying real-time backgrounds, largely replacing green screen.

questions.prompt: Which country lies between Poland and Estonia?
questions.fact: Lithuania borders Poland and Latvia borders Estonia, so the two together fill the gap.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the novel The Old Curiosity Shop?
questions.fact: Crowds reportedly waited at New York docks for the ship carrying the final instalment, shouting to ask if a character lived.

questions.prompt: What does the acronym UX designer primarily study?
questions.fact: Much of the work is watching people fail to do something, which is more informative than asking them.
